subject: Re: Integration discovery — SDK streaming, function calls & rerank fit
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@borealis.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Integration discovery — SDK streaming, function calls & rerank fit

Thanks again for the demo today — good conversation. Quick recap from our side and a few open questions so we all line up before a technical workshop: 

Pain & goals (as discussed)
- We ingest physician notes and need a low-latency rerank step for top-5 candidate retrieval (~30–50ms token latency target)
- Streaming responses for user-facing summaries is a must (partial text needs to render within 200ms)
- Function calling to populate structured EMR fields (FHIR-like output)
- Tight control over PII and retention (SOC2 + contract language)

Technical curiosities / asks
1) How does Redwood handle KV cache behavior across short-lived sessions? Any isolation knobs?
2) Can the SDK stream partial structured outputs (i.e., streaming JSON chunks) while maintaining parseability?
3) Recommended quantization profiles for 24–30 token generation workloads to hit our latency goals

Attachments: borealis-mvp-payloads.json (application/json) — sample request/response pairs

Next steps we propose:
- 1-hour technical spike workshop with your runtime engineers (aim early next week)
- Share SOC2 summary + list of required evidence items
- Get a short mutual action plan and a rough price band

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Head of ML Platforms
Borealis Therapeutics

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@borealis.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Integration discovery — SDK streaming, function calls & rerank fit

Appreciate the clear recap, Alex — that's exactly how we heard it. Below is what I committed to during the call and an initial technical plan so we can keep momentum.

Summary of what we heard (short):
- Primary goal: <200ms perceived streaming start + 30–50ms per-token latency for rerank stage
- Output needs: deterministic structured outputs (FHIR-like) via function-like calls + streaming partial JSON for the UI
- Compliance: SOC2 + evidence, retention controls, and KMS integration

Proposed technical approach (next 7–10 days):
1) Workshop (60–90m): runtime + SDK pairing session — we will bring a runtime engineer and an SDK engineer (we recommend Wednesday or Thursday morning PT)
   - Agenda: tokenization/check sample flows, live perf test with your sample payloads, verify streaming JSON strategy, observe KV cache behavior under short sessions
2) Tech spike deliverables (we will owner):
   - Redwood SDK patch: streaming structured-output example (we'll attach and push a branch)
   - Short perf report: latency distribution for rerank path with your payloads
   - Config knobs doc: caching isolation, TTLs, cold-start guidance
3) Compliance package: we'll send SOC2 summary + checklist in parallel; Marissa will follow up on pricing & MLP credits

Action owners & timeline
- Redwood: runtime + SDK spike (Dylan, Rishi) — deliver by EOD next Friday (2026-04-10)
- Borealis: share any additional sample payloads and your compliance contact (Alex / Priya) — by EOD Monday
- Sales: Marissa to send mutual action plan and provisional pricing bands (Marissa) — by Monday

Attachments included in this thread: redwood-sdk-sample.patch (diff), borealis-mvp-payloads.json (from your email)

Questions I have for your team now:
- Who is your compliance owner? We can route SOC2 evidence there.
- Any constraints on on-prem/private deployment vs hosted during the PoC?

Thanks — we'll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm the workshop slot.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(d) +1 415-555-0172

Alex — quick follow from SA/sales on next commercial and procurement items so your procurement team can be looped: 

Commercial / procurement checklist (initial)
- Mutual action plan (I will send a draft Monday)
- Ballpark pricing: PoC credits + pilot reserved capacity estimate (I will include a high/low band and assumptions)
- Contract docs: NDA already in place; will we need a separate DPA addendum?
- Security evidence: SOC2 report + subservice org list + response time SLA templates (we'll attach)

If you want, we can include a short two-page doc that maps your stated goals to the Redwood PoC success criteria (latency targets, streaming UX, structured-output accuracy) — I think that helps procurement sign off.

I'll also drop a DocuSign link for the standard PoC statement of work if you want the engineering kickoff tied to a minimal PO.

-Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is very helpful. Confirming a couple of items from our side and next steps: 

- Compliance owner: Priya Shah (copied) — I'll send our SOC2 point-of-contact and any redlines we need for the DPA by EOD Tuesday.
- Workshop: Wednesday 2026-04-09 10:00 PT works for our infra + ML engineers. Please send calendar invite.

On the streaming structured outputs question: we care about partial, parseable JSON so the UI can pre-render sections (e.g., patient summary blocks) — happy to walk through an example during the workshop.
